data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin for iOS and Android providing a simple way to display local file PDFs.
data.what_it_does: It displays local PDF files on iOS and Android platforms inside a standard Flutter widget. The plugin uses platform views to render the PDF content natively.
use_when: You need to display local PDF files on iOS and Android.
You want a simple widget-based approach to show PDFs.
avoid_when: You need advanced PDF manipulation, annotation, or search features.
You need to view PDFs on web or desktop platforms.
strengths: Simple widget API for displaying local PDFs
weaknesses: Only supports iOS and Android platforms
Requires platform view configuration on iOS
data.setup_notes: For iOS, add the io.flutter.embedded_views_preview key set to true to ios/Runner/info.plist.
